description: This file implements the SplitSequenceOperator functionality, which traverses an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to detect and split sequence operator expressions, ensuring correct evaluation order and side effect handling in shader code transformations.

classes.name: SplitSequenceOperatorTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that detects sequence operator expressions to be split, handling different node types and managing traversal state.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with pattern mask and symbol table.

methods.description: Resets traversal state for the next iteration.

methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes, detects patterns to split.
